title: Deductible Rewards Claim-Free Year: Claims That Do Not Restart the Year
content:
**Rule.** For the Deductible Rewards claim-free year of a vehicle insured under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage: where the latest paid claim on the coverage was a glass repair from which no deductible was taken, or was recovered in full by subrogation with no share of fault on the Cardinal driver, the period anchor stays the end date of the latest credit entry; where the latest paid claim after that date was any other comprehensive claim, the period anchor is the later of that end date and the claim's loss date; where it was any other claim, the period anchor is the later of that end date and the claim's payment date.

## How the records show each condition

| Condition | Record |
|---|---|
| Latest paid claim | The claim of the latest claim payment on the coverage |
| Glass repair | The claim's estimates show glass repair |
| No deductible taken | The deductible taken on the claim's payments totals 0.00 |
| Recovered in full by subrogation | Subrogation recoveries received on the claim total at least the amount paid on it |
| No share of fault on the Cardinal driver | The claim's latest fault determination shows a share of 0 percent |
| Comprehensive claim | The claim's coverage decision is under comprehensive |
| Loss date, payment date | The claim's loss report; the latest claim payment |

## Decision table

| Latest paid claim | Period anchor |
|---|---|
| Glass repair, no deductible taken | End date of the latest credit entry |
| Recovered in full by subrogation, Cardinal driver's share 0 percent | End date of the latest credit entry |
| Any other comprehensive claim, paid after the latest credit's end date | Later of that end date and the claim's loss date |
| Any other claim, paid after the latest credit's end date | Later of that end date and the claim's payment date |

## Cases (hypothetical dates; latest credit entry ends 2025-06-01)

- A windshield chip repaired with no deductible taken, paid 2025-09-15: the anchor stays 2025-06-01.
- A collision with the other driver fully at fault, the Cardinal driver's share 0 percent, paid 3000.00 on 2025-09-15 and recovered 3000.00 by subrogation: the anchor stays 2025-06-01.
- The same collision recovered 1800.00 only: not recovered in full; the anchor is the payment date, 2025-09-15.
- Hail damage, loss date 2025-08-20, paid 2025-09-15: comprehensive; the anchor is the loss date, 2025-08-20.
- A windshield replaced with a deductible taken, loss date 2025-08-20, paid 2025-09-15: comprehensive but not a no-deductible glass repair; the anchor is 2025-08-20.
